---
title: "forest_plot"
output: html_document
---

### 1. Load Package
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(forestploter)
library(grid)
```

### 2. Prepare Data
```{r}
plot_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~survey, ~follow_up, ~analysis, ~sex, ~n, ~estimate, ~lower_ci, ~upper_ci,

  # SPHC 2010 (followed up until 2014)
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "Complete-case",       "Female", 3231, 5.88, 4.20,  7.98,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "Complete-case",       "Male",   2159, 8.24, 4.89, 13.18,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MI without income",  "Female", 5624, 4.83, 3.47,  6.72,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MI without income",  "Male",   4208, 5.95, 3.73,  9.50,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MI with income", "Female", 5624, 4.65, 3.34,  6.46,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2014", "MI with income", "Male",   4208, 5.53, 3.42,  8.95,

  # SPHC 2010 (followed up until 2021)
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "Complete-case",       "Female", 2463, 6.17, 3.98,  9.12,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "Complete-case",       "Male",   1592, 7.71, 4.26, 13.01,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MI without income",  "Female", 5624, 4.57, 2.91,  7.16,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MI without income",  "Male",   4208, 6.16, 3.49,  10.88,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MI with income", "Female", 5624, 4.26, 2.70,  6.72,
  "SPHC 2010", "2010–2021", "MI with income", "Male",   4208, 5.19, 3.01,  8.94,

  # SPHC 2014 (followed up until 2021)
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "Complete-case",       "Female", 2285, 8.62, 6.36, 11.62,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "Complete-case",       "Male",   1574, 7.85, 4.62, 12.83,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MI without income",  "Female", 3417, 7.68, 5.54, 10.63,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MI without income",  "Male",   2573, 6.59, 4.04, 10.75,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MI with income","Female", 3417, 7.34, 5.52,  9.78,
  "SPHC 2014", "2014–2021", "MI with income","Male",   2573, 6.10, 3.65, 10.20
) %>%
  mutate(
    survey = factor(
      survey,
      levels = c("SPHC 2010", "SPHC 2014")
    ),
    follow_up = factor(
      follow_up,
      levels = c("2010–2014", "2010–2021", "2014–2021")
    ),
    analysis = factor(
      analysis,
      levels = c(
        "Complete-case",
        "MI without income",
        "MI with income"
      )
    ),
    sex = factor(
      sex,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    )
  )

plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
  add_row( analysis = "SPHC 2010 (2010–2014)", .before = 1 )

plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
  add_row( analysis = "SPHC 2010 (2010–2021)", .before = 8 )

plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
  add_row( analysis = "SPHC 2014 (2014–2021)", .before = 15 )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  select( -c(1:2) ) %>%
  rename( Model = analysis,
          sample_size = n )


plot_data$Model <- ifelse( is.na( plot_data$estimate ),
                              plot_data$Model,
                              paste0( "\u2003", plot_data$Model ) )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate( sample_size = prettyNum( sample_size, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none" ) )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(sample_size),
      ~ replace(.x, .x == "NA", "")
    )
  )

str(plot_data)

plot_data$` ` <- paste( rep( " ", 20 ) , collapse = " " )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    `RR (95% CI)` = if_else(
      is.na(estimate),
      "",
      sprintf(
        "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
        estimate, lower_ci, upper_ci
      )
    )
  )
```

### 3. Among Males
```{r}
plot_data_male <- plot_data %>%
  filter( sex == "Male" | is.na( sex ) ) %>%
  add_column( temp1 = " ", .before = 2 ) %>%
  add_column( temp2 = " ", .before = 9 )

plot_data_male_forest <- plot_data_male %>%
  select(1, 2, 4, 8, 9, 10)

names( plot_data_male_forest )[ names( plot_data_male_forest ) %in% c( "model", "temp1", "temp2", "Model", "sample_size", "RR (95% CI)" ) ] <- ""

tm <- forest_theme(
  base_size = 11,
  colhead = list( fg_params = list( fontsize = 11 ) ), 
  base_family = "Arial",
  ci_col = "#0072B2",
  refline_gp = gpar(col = "grey50", lty = "dashed", lwd = 1)
  )

p_rr_male <- forest(
  plot_data_male_forest,
  
  est = plot_data_male$estimate,
  lower = plot_data_male$lower_ci,
  upper = plot_data_male$upper_ci,
  
  ci_column = 4,
  sizes = 0.4,
  
  xlim = c( 0, 14 ),
  ticks_at = seq( 0, 14, 2 ),
  ref_line = 1,
  xlab = "Risk Ratio (95% CI)",
  theme = tm
)

p_rr_male <- edit_plot( 
  p_rr_male,
  row = c( 1, 5, 9 ),
  col = 1,
  gp = gpar( fontface = "bold" )
  )

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Model",
  col = 1,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Size",
  col = 3,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "(95% CI)",
  col = 6,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- insert_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Imputation",
  col = 1,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Sample",
  col = 3,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- add_text(
  p_rr_male,
  text = "Risk Ratio",
  col = 6,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr_male <- edit_plot(
  p_rr_male,
  row = 1:12, 
  which = "background",
  gp = gpar( fill = NA )
  )

p_rr_male <- add_border(
  p_rr_male,
  part = "header",
  row = 2,
  col = 1:6,
  where = "bottom",
  gp = gpar( lwd = 1 )
  )

p_rr_male <- add_border(
  p_rr_male,
  part = "body",
  row = 1:11,
  col = 1:3,
  where = "bottom",
  gp = gpar( lwd = 1, col = "lightgrey" )
  )

p_rr_male <- edit_plot(
  p_rr_male,
  row = c( 4, 8, 12 ),
  col = 4,
  which = "ci",
  gp = gpar(
    col = "red",
    fill = "red"
    )
  )

plot( p_rr_male )
```


```{r}
tm <- forest_theme(
  base_size = 10,
  base_family = "Arial",
  colhead = list( fg_params = list( fontsize = 10 ) ),
  ci_col = "steelblue",
  refline_gp = gpar(
    col = "grey50",
    lty = "dashed",
    lwd = 1
  )
)
  
p <- forest(
  data = plot_data_forest,

  est = list(
    plot_data$estimate_Female,
    plot_data$estimate_Male
  ),

  lower = list(
    plot_data$lower_ci_Female,
    plot_data$lower_ci_Male
  ),

  upper = list(
    plot_data$upper_ci_Female,
    plot_data$upper_ci_Male
  ),

  ci_column = c(3, 7),

  ref_line = 1,

  xlim = list(
    c(0, 14),
    c(0, 14)
  ),

  ticks_at = list(
    c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14),
    c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14)
  ),

  xlab = c(
    "Risk Ratio (95% CI)",
    "Risk Ratio (95% CI)"
  ),

  theme = tm
)

plot(p)
```





#### 4.1. MICE and MIA-ICE
```{r}
results_all <- bind_rows( 
  results_cc,
  results_mia_nice_model_2,
  results_mia_nice_model_3,
  results_mia_nice_model_4,
  results_mia_ice_model_2,
  results_mia_ice_model_3,
  results_mia_ice_model_4,
  results_mi_model_1,
  results_mi_model_2,
  results_mi_model_3,
  results_mi_model_4 )

writexl::write_xlsx( results_all, "results_all.xlsx" )

#results_all <- read_excel(here("results_all.xlsx"))

results_all <- results_all %>%
  filter( !model %in% c( "mia_nice_model_2", "mia_nice_model_3", "mia_nice_model_4" )  ) %>%
  select( model, estimate, lower_ci, upper_ci, sample_size )

desired_order <- c( "mi_model_1", "Complete-case analysis",
                    "mi_model_2", "mia_ice_model_2", 
                    "mi_model_3", "mia_ice_model_3",
                    "mi_model_4", "mia_ice_model_4" )
                    
results_all <- results_all %>%
  mutate( model = factor( model, levels = desired_order ) ) %>%
  arrange( model )

results_all <- results_all %>%
  mutate( sample_size = prettyNum( sample_size, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none" ) )

results_all <- results_all %>% 
  add_row( model = "Model 1", .before = 1 )

results_all <- results_all %>% 
  add_row( model = "Model 2", .before = 4 )

results_all <- results_all %>% 
  add_row( model = "Model 3", .before = 7 )

results_all <- results_all %>% 
  add_row( model = "Model 4", .before = 10 )

results_all$model[ results_all$model == "Complete-case analysis" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MIA (= uCC)" )
results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mi_model_1" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MICE" )
results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mi_model_2" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MICE" )
results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mi_model_3" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MICE" )
results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mi_model_4" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MICE" )

# results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mia_nice_model_2" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MIA-NICE" )
# results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mia_nice_model_3" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MIA-NICE" )
# results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mia_nice_model_4" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MIA-NICE" )

results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mia_ice_model_2" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MIA-ICE" )
results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mia_ice_model_3" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MIA-ICE" )
results_all$model[ results_all$model == "mia_ice_model_4" ] <- paste0( "   ", "MIA-ICE" )

results_all <- results_all %>% 
  add_column( "risk_ratio" = paste0(
    sprintf( "%.2f", results_all$estimate ), " (", 
    sprintf( "%.2f", results_all$lower_ci ), ", ", 
    sprintf( "%.2f", results_all$upper_ci ), ")" ),
    .before = 2 )

results_all$risk_ratio <- ifelse( is.na( results_all$estimate ), "", 
                                  results_all$risk_ratio )

results_all$sample_size <- ifelse( is.na( results_all$estimate ), "",
                                   results_all$sample_size )

results_all <- results_all %>% 
  add_column( ` ` = paste( rep( " ", 20 ) , collapse = " " ), .after = 6 )

results_all <- results_all %>%
  add_column( temp1 = " ", .before = 2 ) %>%
  add_column( temp2 = "  ", .before = 7 ) %>%
  add_column( temp3 = "   ", .before = 9 )

names( results_all )[ names( results_all ) %in% c( "model", "temp1", "temp2", "temp3", "risk_ratio", "sample_size" ) ] <- ""

tm <- forest_theme(
  base_size = 11,
  colhead = list( fg_params = list( fontsize = 11 ) ), 
  base_family = "Arial",
  ci_col = "#0072B2"
  )

p_rr <- forest(
  results_all[ , c( 1:3, 7:10 ) ],
  
  est = results_all$estimate,
  lower = results_all$lower_ci,
  upper = results_all$upper_ci,
  
  ci_column = 7,
  sizes = 0.4,
  
  xlim = c( 8, 20 ),
  ticks_at = c( 8, 12, 16, 20 ),
  xlab = "Risk Ratio (95% CI)",
  theme = tm
)

p_rr <- edit_plot(

  col = 1,
  gp = gpar( fontface = "bold" )
  )

p_rr <- add_text(

  col = 1,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,

  )
)

p_rr <- add_text(

  )
)

p_rr <- add_text(

  col = 5,

  part = "header",

    fontsize = 11,

  )
)

  p_rr,

  col = 1,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr <- add_text(
  p_rr,
  text = "Risk Ratio",
  col = 3,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr <- add_text(
  p_rr,
  text = "Sample",
  col = 5,
  row = 1,
  part = "header",
  gp = gpar(
    fontface = "bold",
    fontsize = 11,
    fontfamily = "Arial"
  )
)

p_rr <- edit_plot(
  p_rr,

  )

p_rr <- add_border(

plot( p_rr )
ggsave( "forest_plot.svg", plot = p_rr, width = 6.5, height = 5 )
```
